_doc: INN_WORLD (feature inn_world): places and people around the Valley Inn. Design: tales-forge-docs docs/design-tin-valley-world.md. New places list their exits; the way back from base places is added by TalesForge.Game.Pack.

innkeep: Anyone carrying steel or asking for work, Brenna sends to Hilde Brask's forge off the Market Square: Hilde puts an honest edge on a blade for 2 copper, pays a strong arm at the bellows, and reads the stamps on any tin or tool.

The hurt and the curious, Brenna sends to Old Maude's cottage off the Market Square, often with a loaf for Maude: Maude stitches cuts for a few coppers and remembers what the first miners found under the hill.
stable_lad: Most evenings he runs bread to Maude's cottage and coal to the forge, and for a copper he will walk a stranger to either, gossiping about Hilde's late hammering and Maude's old stories on the way.
